page.layout: One printed page. At the head: running title left, page number right. Below it, a title block in large capitals with a subtitle, then running text in one column. Section numbers §. 1 and §. 2 stand in the left margin beside their paragraphs. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.l: VALOR
Ratiociniorum in hoc
SERMONE
DEMONSTRATUS.
EX ipsâ versus ultimi conclusione facile
constat, quem scopum collimet praesens
Vatis nostri disceptatio: ut scilicet
non intendat omnem à populo castigationem divinam
avertere, sed foluminodo[?] mitigationem
ejus impetrare. Metus est, à crudelissimo & superbissimo
hoste nil exspectandum esse, praeter universum populi judaici
excidium, quo cum etiam omni per Mosen
praescripto legis cultui interitum minabatur. Negat ul-lam ab
istius ingenii hoste miserationem aut clementiam esse
sperandam Judæis, nisi Deus huic monarchiæ
terminos, & monarchæ modum ponat.
Rationes, quarum pondera nobis expendenda
sunt, id solidissimè urgent, *quod intendunt justi.
1. Ratio prior, à foedere Dei desumpta, per
modum restipulationis repetit promissorum in foedere prae-
stationem: addixerat enim Jehovah patribus se fore
illis, nec non femini eorum (id est posteris Judaeis) in
Deum, & quidem לְעוֹלָם[?] in aeternum; quâ tran-
sfactione in se susceperat hunc populum ut cultorem & clientem suum

page.notes: Printed "foluminodo" (for solummodo) is doubtful; kept as printed with [?]. The Hebrew word לעולם is read from a small, faded scan; vowel points are uncertain. The catchword "vâ" is faint. The "*" before "quod" is a printed mark, kept as is. A stray dot after "ponat." is not text and was left out. The woodcut initial E is read as "EX". The foot line in main_text duplicates the signature and is not printed on the page; it should be removed.
